changes_reviewed: Bubblewrap adds only protected Git environment GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1, KEY_0=safe.directory, VALUE_0=/workspace after clearenv; no wildcard or host/global Git configuration inheritance.
Dedicated Git tools add exact -c safe.directory=/workspace and disable external diff/textconv for diff and show while retaining fsmonitor/hooks/pager overrides.
Existing offline unshare-net, read-only Git metadata mount, tool authorization, publication gates and scope checks remain unchanged.
nonblocking_observations: Explicitly trusting the selected mounted repository allows Git to read its local configuration. Generic exec already authorizes arbitrary offline sandbox commands; this change does not grant host/network access. Dedicated inspection retains helper restrictions.
The environment only trusts the exact mounted root; the native child-repository owner-mismatch negative test still returns dubious ownership.
Capability inventory repair in other modules reviewed separately; this record covers only the two Git/sandbox modules and focused tests.

Distinct nested repository remains untrusted under assumed owner mismatch.
No inherited wildcard/host config and no external-diff/textconv execution in dedicated diff.
Read-only metadata, offline networking, host identity isolation and Git publishing/fetch permission regressions pass.
